translations.idiomatic: Guangzan was campaigning deputy at Qingzhou; when Yang Guangyuan's rebellion was crushed he was demoted to deputy at Shangzhou, later recalled under amnesty, and soon died at home.

sentences.zh: 符彥饒，唐莊宗朝蕃漢總管存審之第二字也。

translations.literal: Fu Yanrao was the second son of Cun Shen, overall commander of barbarian and Han forces in the Tang Zhuangzong reign.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanrao was the second son of Cun Shen, the barbarian and Han overall commander under Zhuangzong.

sentences.zh: 存審，《唐書》有傳。

translations.literal: Cun Shen has a biography in the Book of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Cun Shen has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

sentences.zh: 彥饒少驍勇，能騎射。

translations.literal: Yanrao in youth was brave and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Yanrao was brave and skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 唐天祐十五年冬，莊宗與梁大戰於胡柳陂，彥饒與弟彥圖俱從其父血戰，有功，莊宗壯之，因用為騎將。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year of Tang Tianyou Zhuangzong fought a great battle with Liang at Huliu Slope; Yanrao and his younger brother Yantu both followed their father in bloody combat with merit; Zhuangzong admired them and therefore employed Yanrao as a cavalry officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianyou 15 (918) Zhuangzong fought the Liang at Huliu Slope; Yanrao and his brother Yantu fought beside their father with distinction; Zhuangzong admired them and made Yanrao a cavalry officer.

sentences.zh: 同光中，以功授曹州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tongguang, for his merit he was made prefect of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongguang he was made prefect of Caozhou for his merit.

sentences.zh: 明宗即位，改刺沂州。

translations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he was transferred to govern Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong acceded he was transferred to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 天成中，屯守梁園，會起軍北戍塞下，時有偏校以宣武之帥，迫彥饒為之，彥饒紿許其請，明日，殺為惡者奏之，時人嘉其方略。

translations.literal: During Tiancheng he garrisoned Liangyuan; when troops were raised to garrison the northern frontier, a deputy officer used the commander of Xuanwu to force Yanrao to become their leader; Yanrao deceived them by pretending to agree to their request; the next day he killed the ringleaders and reported it; people of the time praised his stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he garrisoned Liangyuan; when troops were raised for the northern frontier, a deputy tried to force him to lead a mutiny in the name of the Xuanwu commander; Yanrao pretended to agree, then killed the ringleaders the next day and reported them—people praised his handling.

sentences.zh: 長興中，為金州防禦使，為政甚有民譽，其後略遷節鎮。

translations.literal: During Changxing he was defense commissioner of Jin Prefecture; his government won great popular reputation, and afterward he was briefly transferred among frontier commands.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing he was defense commissioner of Jinzhou and won a strong reputation; he was later transferred among frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 天福初，為滑州節度使，累官至檢校太傅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he was military governor of Hua Prefecture and rose in office to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianfu he became military governor of Huazhou and eventually Honorary Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，範延光據鄴都叛，朝廷遣侍衛馬軍都指揮使白奉進率騎軍三千，屯於州之開元寺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang held Yedu in rebellion; the court sent the Palace Guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin leading three thousand horsemen to encamp at the Kaiyuan Temple in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang rebelled at Yedu; the court sent Palace Guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin with three thousand horsemen to camp at Huazhou's Kaiyuan Temple.

sentences.zh: 一日，彥饒與奉進因事忿爭於牙署，事具奉進傳中。

translations.literal: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled angrily over a matter at the headquarters; the affair is fully recorded in Fengjin's biography.
translations.idiomatic: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled at headquarters; the full account is in Fengjin's biography.

sentences.zh: 是時，奉進厲聲曰：「爾莫是與範延光同反耶？

translations.literal: At that time Fengjin said in a harsh voice: "Are you not rebelling together with Fan Yanguang?
translations.idiomatic: Fengjin shouted, "Are you in league with Fan Yanguang's rebellion?

sentences.zh: 」拂衣而起，彥饒不留，帳下介士大噪，擒奉進殺之。

translations.literal: " He brushed his robe and rose; Yanrao did not detain him; the staff warriors under the tent made a great clamor, seized Fengjin, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " He stormed off; Yanrao did not stop him; his guards raised an uproar, seized Fengjin, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 奉進從騎散走，傳呼於外。

translations.literal: Fengjin's escort horsemen scattered and fled, calling out beyond.
translations.idiomatic: Fengjin's escort scattered, shouting the alarm outside.

sentences.zh: 時步軍都校馬萬、次校盧順密聞奉進被害，即率其部眾攻滑之子城，執彥饒以出。

translations.literal: At that time the infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, at once led their troops to attack the subsidiary city of Hua, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.
translations.idiomatic: Infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy Lu Shunmi, hearing Fengjin was dead, attacked Huazhou's outer city, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.

sentences.zh: 遣裨校方太拘送闕下，行及赤岡南，高祖遣中使害於路左。

translations.literal: They sent the deputy Fang Tai to escort him under guard to court; when they reached south of Chigang the High Ancestor sent a palace envoy to kill him on the left of the road.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Fang Tai escorted him toward court; south of Chigang Gaozu sent an envoy to execute him on the road.

sentences.zh: 羅周敬，字尚素，鄴王紹威之弟三子也。

translations.literal: Luo Zhoujing, styled Shangsu, was the third son of Prince of Ye Shaowei.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zhoujing, courtesy name Shangsu, was the third son of Prince of Ye Shaowei.

sentences.zh: 紹威，《梁書》有傳。

translations.literal: Shaowei has a biography in the Book of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Shaowei has a biography in the 《Book of Liang》.

sentences.zh: 周敬幼聰明，八歲學為詩，往往傳於人口，起家授檢校尚書、禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Zhoujing was clever in youth; at eight he learned to compose poetry, which often passed from people's mouths; on entering service he was appointed Acting Director of the Secretariat and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhoujing was clever as a child; at eight he wrote verse that people repeated; on entering service he was made Honorary Director of the Secretariat and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 梁乾化中，以兄周翰節制滑臺，卒於官，乃以周敬繼之，命為兩使留後，尋正授旄鉞，時年十歲。

translations.literal: During Liang Qianhua his elder brother Zhouhan commanded Huatai and died in office; Zhoujing was then made to succeed him, ordered as acting military governor of the two circuits, and shortly given the full commission with banners and axes—he was ten years old at the time.
translations.idiomatic: During Liang Qianhua his brother Zhouhan governed Huatai and died in office; Zhoujing succeeded him as acting governor at age ten and soon received the full military commission.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改授許州節度使，繼加檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to military governor of Xu Prefecture and then given the honorary title of Acting Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to military governor of Xuzhou and made Honorary Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 逾三年，征授秘書監、檢校司空、駙馬都尉，尚梁普安公主，旋移光祿卿。

translations.literal: After more than three years he was summoned and made Director of the Secretariat, Acting Minister of Works, and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law; he married the Liang Princess Pu'an and shortly was transferred to Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: After three years he was summoned as Director of the Secretariat, Honorary Minister of Works, and Imperial Son-in-Law; he married Liang Princess Pu'an and soon became Minister of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 莊宗即位，歷左右金吾大將軍。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he served successively as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Guards.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong acceded he served as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Guards in turn.

sentences.zh: 初，唐天祐中，紹威嘗建第於洛陽福善裏，及莊宗入洛，以梁租庸使趙巖宅賜明宗。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Tang Tianyou, Shaowei had once built a mansion in Fushan Lane in Luoyang; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang the residence of the Liang commissioner for rent and corvée Zhao Yan was given to Mingzong.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Tianyou Shaowei had built a mansion in Luoyang's Fushan Lane; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang, Liang rent commissioner Zhao Yan's house was given to Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 同光中，明宗在洛，以趨內稍遠，乃召周敬議易其第，周敬諾之。

translations.literal: During Tongguang Mingzong was in Luoyang; because going to court was somewhat far, he summoned Zhoujing to discuss exchanging his mansion, and Zhoujing agreed.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongguang Mingzong found the ride to court too long from Zhao Yan's house and asked Zhoujing to swap mansions; Zhoujing agreed.

sentences.zh: 後明宗即位，一日夢中見一人，儀形瑰秀，若素識者，夢中問曰：「此得非前宅主羅氏子？

translations.literal: Later when Mingzong took the throne, one day in a dream he saw a man of splendid and handsome bearing, as if someone he had long known; in the dream he asked: "Is this not the son of the Luo family, the former master of the house?
translations.idiomatic: After Mingzong acceded he dreamed one day of a handsome man who seemed familiar and asked in the dream, "Is this not the Luo boy who owned the house before?

sentences.zh: 」及寤，訪其子孫，左右對曰：「周敬見列明廷。

translations.literal: " When he awoke he inquired after his descendants; those beside him replied: "Zhoujing is present at the bright court.
translations.idiomatic: " On waking he asked after the family; his attendants said, "Zhoujing is at court today.

sentences.zh: 」召至，果符夢中所見。

translations.literal: " He was summoned, and indeed matched what he had seen in the dream.
translations.idiomatic: " He was summoned and matched the dream exactly.

sentences.zh: 明宗謂侍臣曰：「朕不欲使大勛之後久無土地。

translations.literal: Mingzong said to his attending ministers: "I do not wish the descendants of great merit to long be without lands.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong told his ministers, "I do not want the descendants of great merit to remain landless.

sentences.zh: 」因授同州節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: " He therefore appointed him military governor of Tong Prefecture and added Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: " He made him military governor of Tongzhou and Honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 長興中，入為左監門衛上將軍，四遷諸衛上將軍。

translations.literal: During Changxing he entered court as senior general of the Left Gate Guard and was transferred four times among senior generals of the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing he became senior general of the Left Gate Guard and was transferred four times among the guard commands.

sentences.zh: 天福二年卒，時年三十二。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Tianfu, aged thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second Tianfu year (937) at thirty-two.

sentences.zh: 贈太傅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
